metadata.header: Porto Taxi Route Variation under Operating Conditions
metadata.dataset_description: A constructed set of 720 Porto taxi trips across four recurrent OD pairs, five route families, ten geometry variants, three departure periods, two weather conditions, and three request sources. Every GPS path follows the Porto OSM road graph.

insights: Trips between recurrent origin–destination pairs usually follow a few dominant routes, while a smaller group uses substantially longer alternatives.
Rainy morning and evening peaks show greater route dispersion than comparable dry periods, while late-night routes remain relatively stable.
Street-hail trips show greater route variation than stand-originated trips for comparable origin–destination pairs, distances, and departure periods.
summary: Most recurrent OD trips use the primary or parallel route families, while a smaller set takes materially longer alternatives. Route-family dispersion increases during rainy morning and evening peaks but remains stable late at night. Within distance-matched route sets, street-hail trips vary more than taxi-stand trips.
